posts.en:
dsh-cdp-browser is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. CDP bridge to an already-running Chrome/Edge for DSH: screenshots, pixel assertions, DOM/CSS checks, and page JS evaluation over HTTP + WebSocket, with zero child processes, zero npm dependencies, and zero per-use approval.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-f38c019431bb794ab279.html
